```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load the project's functions from the checkout (decision 0042) and read the
# published data bundle, so this code reproduces the figure (decision 0040).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
release <- data_release_date()
ps <- collect(tbl(con, "ps_change"))
career <- collect(tbl(con, "career_summary"))
DBI::dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)
# The current college season is still being played, so it is left out of the
# rates: its stat lines are partial (decision 0053 and the card rules).
through <- last_complete_cfb_season()
```

```{r}
#| label: figure
# Each season's share of player-seasons that were at a new school. Dark points
# are the seasons after the one-time transfer waiver, so the change reads at a
# glance.
by_season <- transfer_share_by_season(ps, through = through) |>
  filter(season >= 2011) |>
  mutate(
    era = if_else(season >= 2021L, "waiver", "before"),
    tip = sprintf(
      "%d: %.1f%% of players at a new school (%s of %s)",
      season,
      100 * share,
      fmt(transfers),
      fmt(seasons)
    )
  )

p <- ggplot(by_season, aes(season, 100 * share)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2, colour = "gray70") +
  geom_point_interactive(
    aes(colour = era, tooltip = tip, data_id = season),
    size = 3.6
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(before = "gray60", waiver = "#374151"),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2011, max(by_season$season), by = 3)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA)) +
  labs(
    title = "Players at a new school each season",
    subtitle = "Share of players at a new school; dark: waiver era",
    x = "Season",
    y = "Share (%)",
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card()

card_thumbnail(p, "transfer-share-by-season", release = release)
card_interactive(p)
```

```{r}
#| label: destination
# The same seasons split by the tier of the new school, one line a tier.
by_dest <- ps |>
  filter(season >= 2011, !is.na(tier), transferred %in% TRUE) |>
  count(season, tier, name = "transfers") |>
  left_join(
    ps |>
      filter(season >= 2011, !is.na(tier)) |>
      count(season, tier, name = "seasons"),
    by = c("season", "tier")
  ) |>
  filter(season <= through) |>
  mutate(
    to = factor(
      c(`1` = "FCS and below", `2` = "Group of Five", `3` = "Power")[as.character(tier)],
      levels = transfer_tier_levels()
    ),
    share = transfers / seasons,
    tip = sprintf(
      "%s, %d: %.1f%% of its players arrived from another school (%s of %s)",
      to,
      season,
      100 * share,
      fmt(transfers),
      fmt(seasons)
    )
  )

p_dest <- ggplot(by_dest, aes(season, 100 * share, colour = to)) +
  geom_line_interactive(aes(data_id = to, tooltip = to), linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point_interactive(aes(data_id = to, tooltip = tip), size = 2.6) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "FCS and below" = "#9CA3AF",
      "Group of Five" = "#374151",
      "Power" = "#1B9E77"
    )
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2011, max(by_dest$season), by = 3)) +
  labs(
    title = "Every competition tier took on more newcomers",
    subtitle = "Share of each tier's players who arrived from another school, by the tier of the new school",
    x = "Season",
    y = "Players new to their school (%)",
    colour = "Tier of the new school",
    caption = "Hover a point for the counts; hover a line to isolate one tier."
  ) +
  theme_card()
card_interactive(p_dest)
```

```{r}
#| label: career-table
# Over whole careers, how many players changed schools at least once.
rate <- transfer_rate(career)
ci <- wilson(rate$transferred, rate$players)
tibble(
  players = fmt(rate$players),
  changed = fmt(rate$transferred),
  rate = pct(rate$share),
  interval = paste(pct(ci[["lo"]]), "to", pct(ci[["hi"]]))
) |>
  knitr::kable(
    col.names = c(
      "Players",
      "Changed schools at least once",
      "Share",
      "95% confidence interval"
    ),
    caption = "Players with at least one school change over their careers, across every season in the data. A move counts only when both seasons carry a stat line."
  )
```
